script.viz:tip: Run code when this action executes.

assign.viz:tip: Assign an expression result into a data location.

viz:attribute.name: expr
viz:attribute.tip: Script expression to evaluate and assign, e.g. `timer + 1`

log.viz:tip: Write a diagnostic message to the platform log.

viz:attribute.name: label
viz:attribute.tip: Label prefix for the log message. Example: cook

viz:attribute.name: id
viz:attribute.tip: Identifier used to later cancel this send, e.g. `delayed_timeout`

viz:attribute.name: delay
viz:attribute.tip: Delay before sending; SCXML duration string, e.g. `1s`

viz:attribute.name: namelist
viz:attribute.tip: Space-separated data names to include, e.g. `timer cook_time`

viz:attribute.name: sendid
viz:attribute.tip: id of the pending send to cancel, e.g. `delayed_timeout`
